talents.name: The Kingmaker
talents.exact_client_text:
<style="Inline_Underline">Start of Combat</style>: Grant <style="Inline_Buff">Reflect</style> ({effect_group=1:effect=1:chance}) versus Active <style="Inline_Command">Commands</style> and <style="InlineSprite_Talent">Talents</style> to the Ally Dragon deployed in the <style="Inline_Vanguard">Vanguard</style> until the end of Combat. 
<style="Inline_Buff">Reflect</style> causes each instance of the specified damage against the target to have a chance to be split between the target and the source of the attack. Each target's mitigation stats will affect the final damage they take. Reflect (Damage) effects are limited to 1 effect per target.

<style="Inline_Underline">Start of each Round</style>: Increase the <style="Inline_Buff"></style>Damage Dealt by {effect_group=2:effect=1:base_mod} of the Ally Dragon deployed in the <style="Inline_Vanguard">Vanguard</style> until the end of the round. This effect is increased by 1.5x ({effect_group=3:effect=1:base_mod}) when the target is <style="Inline_Bold">below 75% Troop Capacity</style>, and by 2x ({effect_group=4:effect=1:base_mod}) when the target is <style="Inline_Bold">below 50% Troop Capacity</style>.

<style="Inline_Bold">Bonus:</style> This effect only progresses at Ranks 1, 10, and 20.
<style="Inline_Underline">Start of Round 1</style>: Increase the <style="Inline_Buff"></style><style="Inline_Dragon_Strength">Strength</style>, <style="Inline_Dragon_Intelligence">Intelligence</style>, and <style="Inline_Dragon_Instinct">Instinct</style> by {effect_group=5:effect=1:base_mod} of the Ally Dragon deployed in the <style="Inline_Vanguard">Vanguard</style> until the end of Combat.
